title: This Is the Future of Gravel Bikes: 6 Bikes Tested Head to Head on a 100km Ride
content:
We put our test bikes head to head on a 100km test route from Squamish to Whistler. This route has a little bit of everything, challenging each bike in a different way.

Read the full article at This Is the Future of Gravel Bikes: 6 Bikes Tested Head to Head on a 100km Ride on Velo.
author: Will Tracy
